headline: PSD conditions adoption of the 2027 budget on administrative reform: 'The state tightens its belt, not the citizens'
summary: PSD conditions adoption of the 2027 budget on administrative reform and criticizes fiscal measures promoted by Prime Minister Bolojan. It accuses the government of shifting consolidation costs onto citizens and companies.
why: The national budget sets tax and spending levels that affect Romania's deficit, sovereign credit ratings and the outlook for domestic companies. Political support in parliament determines whether budgets pass.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: PSD condiționează adoptarea bugetului pe 2027 de reforma administrației: ”Statul strânge cureaua, nu cetățenii”
